about: Editor usage (the usage field of a material entry, Radiant's Usage filter) for a material a map draws. No game stores it. Chosen from the BO3 techset the material ends up with (its category and type) and what the map measured; docs/hydrax-port/p2-usage.md has every number. Rules are tried in order, first match wins; a rule's fields must all match.
population: Treyarch's own material rows of gdt.db under the StockIndex filter (16,057 materials, 2,028 with a usage other than <not in editor>), measured 2026-11-05. A rate is the share of the materials that match the rule and have a usage which agree with it; the materials left <not in editor> are the ones no map used.

rules.basis: hypothesis: a mesh the game names terrain draws a terrain layer; stock has 143 terrain materials (65 lit, 47 of category Decal), the role itself is not in stock data
hypothesis: the map's sky model; stock has 6 sky materials, 4 of 5 non-decal materials with sky in the name are sky (n=5)
tested: category Tools with a usage 204; name token clip: clip 106 of 107
tested: category Tools without the clip token: tools 96 of 97
tested: category Decal with a usage 624: decal 496 (79.5%); terrain 47, exterior wall 19, floor 18, interior wall 14 (terrain layers are caught by role_terrain first)
tested: techset glass* with a usage 18: window 15 (83.3%)
tested: techset water_shore* with a usage 5: water 5 (small sample)
hypothesis: 9 stock sky_* materials, all <not in editor> (none is in a map), so stock neither agrees nor disagrees; sky is the only usage that fits

tie_rule: a token is adopted at precision 0.85 or more over at least 10 non-decal, non-tool materials with a usage; it decides only where the facing is not usable (no triangle measured, or the two largest facings tie)
